content.content: Capture reads the op head before the operation runs and again after. The two reads bound the run window, and what the bracket keeps is the entries the operation created within it; the run itself is untouched.
content.rationale: Reading the op head twice is what bounds the run window; fixing read-run-read as the capture protocol keeps marker feed independent of what the operation does. The read capability stays where `ukrxptzm` put it — this leaf only fixes the bracketing that uses it.
